{{Top|leg}}
'''War chariots''' were primitive vehicles produced by societies without advanced technology. Members of the primitive [[Species/Legends|species]] could be adept in constructing war chariots, as well as using [[Bow/Legends|bows]] and [[Spear/Legends|spears]], as well as [[Farm/Legends|farming]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
